First, convert 49 weeks and 2 days to days:  
49 weeks × 7 days/week = 343 days  
343 + 2 = 345 days earlier.

Date given: 1247-01-07 (assuming format is DD-MM-YYYY, so 07-01-1247 → 1247-01-07).  
Subtract 345 days from 1247-01-07:  

1246 is not a leap year (divisible by 2 → no).  
From 1247-01-07 back 7 days → 1246-12-31.  
Remaining days: 345 − 7 = 338 days earlier from 1246-12-31.  

1246 has 365 days.  
365 − 338 = 27 → means going back 338 days from 1246-12-31 lands on day-of-year 27 of 1246.  

Day 27 of 1246: January 27, 1246.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1246-01-27
